# Save plan handoff

`customer_support.df.churn_signal_detection.save_plan_handoff` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Save-plan handoff — a flag names the evidence, the person whose confidence was lost, and the owner of the next commercial conversation.

A flag missing any of these is a mood, and moods get filed. Naming the lost confidence matters most: it converts an account-level abstraction into a specific human whose mind someone can go and change.
